# Lights Out

**Time Limit:** `500 ms`  
**Memory Limit:** `512 MB`  
**Source:** [https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/lights-out/](https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/lights-out/)  

---

You have some lightbulbs displayed in a matrix of $N$ rows and $M$ columns. You know for each of them whether they are initially turned on or off. On this matrix you can perform the following type of operation:

Choose a row $r$ and a column $c$ and switch the state of all the lightbulbs on row $r$ and column $c$. The state of the lightbulb that lies both on row $r$ and column $c$ doesn't change.

You should turn off all the lighbulbs using a minimum number of operations.

### Standard input

The first line contains the two integers $N$ and $M$.

Each of the next $N$ lines contains $M$ integers describing the state of the lightbulbs - $0$ if the lightbulb is turned off, $1$ if it is turned on.

### Standard output

If there is no solution output a single integer $-1$.

Otherwise, the first line should contain a single integer representing the minimum number of operations needed. The following lines should each contain two integers $r$ and $c$ describing an operation.

### Constraints and notes

$1 \leq N, M \leq 500$If the solution is not unique you can print any of them.
